name: Analyze Copy Number Purity Ploidy And Focal Events
description: CNVkit-based copy number workflow performing CNV segmentation, purity & ploidy approximation, simplified HRD-style metrics, and focal amplification/deletion detection in selected genes.
detailed_description: CNVkit-based copy number workflow performing CNV segmentation, purity & ploidy approximation, simplified HRD-style metrics, and focal amplification/deletion detection in selected genes.
when_to_use: When you need analyze copy number purity ploidy and focal events analysis

parameters.normal_bam: [Optional] Path to matched normal BAM (recommended for CNVkit)
parameters.output_dir: [Optional] Directory to store CNVkit workflow outputs (default: cn_analysis_results)
parameters.targets_bed: [Optional] BED file of target regions for CNVkit (panel/exome)
parameters.antitargets_bed: [Optional] BED file of antitarget regions for CNVkit
parameters.gene_bed: [Optional] Gene BED (chrom, start, end, gene) for focal event annotation
parameters.focal_genes: [Optional] Genes to highlight for focal events (defaults: MYC, ERBB2, CDKN2A)
parameters.log2_amp_threshold: [Optional] Log2 ratio threshold for focal amplification calls (default: 1.0)
parameters.log2_del_threshold: [Optional] Log2 ratio threshold for focal deep deletion calls (default: -1.0)
